about.title: About
about.paragraph1: I'm a full-stack developer passionate about building performant, elegant web experiences — comfortable working on backend architecture as well as the interface details that matter to end users.
about.paragraph2: Curious and autonomous, I like understanding the business context before writing code, and I care deeply about quality, performance and accessibility in everything I ship.
